source: Illustrative benchmark modeled on published Visa USA and Mastercard U.S. interchange schedules (restaurant categories) and typical interchange-plus markups for $1M-$2M/yr merchants. Not a quote.
notes: For a full-service restaurant with ~$48 average ticket and a high card-present share, a fair interchange-plus deal is roughly 0.15%-0.30% + $0.05-$0.10 per transaction with no monthly junk fees.
